title: pretty LEORA|Plus Size Pleated Tie-Waist Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Designed for comfort and elegance, this plus-size chiffon dress features soft pleating that creates a flowing, flattering silhouette. The tie waist defines the shape naturally, while the lightweight fabric allows easy movement throughout the day. A versatile option for bridesmaids, formal ceremonies, and coordinated wedding looks.

Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.

Length: Floor-Length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: No zipper.

Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: No stretch.
